C0737.title: Security Guards Turned Insider Accomplices in 123 Heists at Hubei Company
C0737.summary: Security team members Wang and Zhang at a company in Gong'an County, Hubei Province, were bribed by external individuals to act as insiders, colluding in repeated thefts. The group committed 123 thefts involving 10 individuals. The Gong'an County Procuratorate prosecuted the case for theft and concealing or disguising criminal proceeds.

references.title: Hubei Gong'an Procuratorate Intervenes Early to Protect Enterprise Rights
